what: float64 Gram matrix K = J J^T of PDE residual gradients over every weight, bias and readout parameter of deep tanh MLPs with D > H, u(z) = wo . tanh(W_L ... tanh(W_1 z + b_1) ...) + bo, W_1 of shape (H, D), and the damped Gauss-Newton step: gram = (r, K); gn = (0.5 |r|^2, step). Candidate = omnibias.jax.experimental.projected_gram: the residual depends on the first layer through W_1 A W_1^T and the drift tangents only, so the streams carry k = min(rank, H) projected tangent columns and the first-layer gradient of row b is q_b x_b^T + Q^F_b Omega + Q^V_b V^T from the projected cotangents; its block of K is formed from inner products of q, Q^F, Q^V and x without the H x D rows; hidden layers by the per-layer rule of the residual-Gram module. The claim regime D / H >= 16 was set on separate calibration cells; the two cells with D / H of 5-6 are controls where the first layer is a minor part of the cost. The tier 'projected without identity' feeds the same projected streams and cotangents to explicit first-layer rows (the module's own ablation) and to vmap(grad) through the projected Laplacian; the other tiers use the full-seed streams of the residual-Gram module or generic one-point engines
hardware: one NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB (exclusive), JAX 0.10.2 with jaxlib 0.10.2 CUDA 12 plugins, CPython 3.12

protocol.repetitions: 3 fresh processes (paired by repetition, rotating method order)
protocol.statistic: ratio = strongest-control median / candidate median per tier; lower95 = exp(mean(log r) - 2.920 sd(log r)/sqrt(3)); strongest control = smallest mean log median among qualified tier members
protocol.qualification: every method's gram and gn programs on a reduced instance (width 4, D_q = min(D, 5) > 4 so the projection is active, B = 4 interior points (+ 1 boundary point), same depth and operator, seed + 1) vs a 50-digit oracle (Taylor series per coordinate direction through the network, no projection, J by central differences in every parameter, step by an LU solve in 50 digits): r and K 1e-12 + 1e-10 max |ref|, loss 1e-12 + 1e-10 |ref|, step 1e-12 + 1e-8 max |ref|; the candidate and its explicit-first-layer ablation pass both under the rule and with the identity forced on every hidden layer; full-size outputs finite and digest-checked

status.parity: lower95 < 1 <= ratio or ratio < 1 <= upper bound
status.partial: an applicable tier member failed (e.g. out of memory) or did not qualify; never promoted

protocol.fairness: identical data, initialisation, loss and float64 inputs for every method; compilation excluded (value-and-gradient steady state)

tiers.projected_without_identity: the same projected streams and cotangents with the first-layer rows formed explicitly, proj_explicit; and vmap(grad) through projected_deep_laplacian, proj_vmap
tiers.explicit_jacobian_full_seed: the full J from the full-seed stream cotangents, rg_lib.explicit_J; K = J J^T
tiers.a26_stream_module: omnibias.jax.experimental.residual_gram: full-seed streams, per-layer rule, explicit first layer
tiers.per_row_forward_laplacian: vmap(grad) through full-seed one-point forward-Laplacian engines: rg_lib stream recursion, omnibias.jax.laplacian.deep_field_value_grad_laplacian, folx.forward_laplacian
tiers.taylor_mode: vmap(grad) through jax.experimental.jet along every input direction
tiers.nested_autodiff: vmap(grad) through jax.grad and jax.hessian; D <= 1024 only

roles.held_out: cells, operators and seed not used for any tuning

full_size_accuracy.what: max over repetitions of per-field relative deviations (norms and sampled entries scaled by the largest sampled reference magnitude) between methods at full size; floor = two controls

cold_cost.what: per cell, medians over repetitions: cold = lowering + compilation ms (excluded from the speed ratios), steady = steady-state median ms, for the candidate and the steady-state-fastest member of every tier; break_even_calls = extra cold ms / steady saving per call (only when the candidate compiles slower and runs faster)
